observations: Studio 0.19.0: Run opened the factory in a second window and the real VM printed 30 after the journey.
Semantic failure stopped in Room 4; later phases were Not Executed and execution remained Not Run.
Two console input requests accepted 80 and 100 and produced 80; clearing visible output preserved report output.
Actual parser/AST nodes, selection, expansion and zoom were inspected. IDE light/dark settings synchronized with the second window.
Debugger Step Over reached source line 2 and showed local a=10. A real 2D game initialized in the preserved canvas.
JSON report, compiler SVG and actual game-frame SVG downloads completed. Stop changed actual runtime status to Stopped.
A real invalid array access produced RUN-01 at source line 3, column 15 after all six compiler phases passed.
While the journey was paused, changing the editor to print 99 marked the snapshot changed; the captured add(10,20) program still printed 30.
Restart, pause, previous/next, reset, zoom, auto-camera and rerun controls were exercised. Logs displayed full chronological timestamps.
